items.text: Two or Three Players: Cards dealt as for four players; absent players' cards are dealt face up and played by the partners of the missing players.

Zifuli: Five-player version. Matto ranks between Nulla and Inn. Eight cards each in batches of four. Bidding to determine partnerships by naming a card; holder of other copy is partner. Lower card of same suit overcall. Bidder's side wins or loses stakes.
